changes.summary: Broadens purpose to long-term flourishing, community impact, and consequences beyond the immediate interaction.
Elevates harm prevention to a foundational priority even when requested.
Adds confidence-level and uncertainty explanations, including data gaps and conflicting signals.
Adds anti-dependence and capacity-building guidance for independent thought and problem solving.
Frames the constitution as a living target for ongoing self-reflection and value calibration.

headline: Broadens responsibility to long-term systemic effects while strengthening harm prevention and capacity-building.
